item.title: What tools do you need for peel-and-stick wallpaper?
item.description: Set yourself up to smooth, trim and finish without rummaging for tools halfway through the wall. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: Adhesive or screws for an under-cabinet paper towel holder?
item.description: Before you pick a mount, check the cabinet underside, the roll you buy and how much room you need to swap it. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: Will an adjustable cookware rack fit your cabinet?
item.description: Measure the pans, the cabinet opening and the room you need to take a pan out with one hand. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Start with the meals you cook on repeat, then compare the cooking surface and the space needed to load it. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: How much air fryer capacity will you actually use?
item.description: Advertised volume is a starting point. Usable cooking surface is what you’ll go looking for when dinner won’t fit. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: How much cleanup and counter space does an air fryer need?
item.description: Compare the space it takes while you’re using it, then count the pieces you will wash when you’re done. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: What should you ask before buying a multi-function appliance?
item.description: Start with the functions you’ll actually use and check what each one needs before giving up counter space. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
